race_human_second_wind.name: Second Wind
race_human_second_wind.description: Restore 30% stamina and hunger at once. 3 min cooldown.

race_human_signal_flare.name: Signal Flare
race_human_signal_flare.description: Fire a flare that lights the area and makes enemies within 24 blocks glow for 10 s. 2 min cooldown.

race_feline_pounce.name: Pounce
race_feline_pounce.description: Leap 6 blocks forward; land without fall damage. 15 s cooldown.

race_feline_twitching_whiskers.name: Twitching Whiskers
race_feline_twitching_whiskers.description: Shows the hostile mobs within 20 blocks through walls for 8 s. 60 s cooldown.

race_merling_dolphin_s_grace.name: Dolphin's Grace
race_merling_dolphin_s_grace.description: Dolphin's Grace for 30 s. 90 s cooldown.

race_merling_rain_dance.name: Rain Dance
race_merling_rain_dance.description: Starts rain for 2 minutes. 30 min cooldown.

race_arachnae_web_shot.name: Web Shot
race_arachnae_web_shot.description: Shoot a web that holds the first enemy hit in place for 2 s. 12 s cooldown.

race_arachnae_egg_sac.name: Egg Sac
race_arachnae_egg_sac.description: Hatch two small spiders that fight for you for 20 s. 2 min cooldown.

race_dwarf_field_forge.name: Field Forge
race_dwarf_field_forge.description: Repair the item in your hand by 15% of its durability. 5 min cooldown.

race_dwarf_smelt.name: Smelt
race_dwarf_smelt.description: Smelt up to 8 ores in your hand at once. 3 min cooldown.

race_wood_elf_fletch.name: Fletch
race_wood_elf_fletch.description: Make 8 arrows from nothing. 3 min cooldown.

race_wood_elf_elven_grace.name: Elven Grace
race_wood_elf_elven_grace.description: No fall damage and Speed I for 20 s. 2 min cooldown.

race_goblin_snare_trap.name: Snare Trap
race_goblin_snare_trap.description: Place a trap that roots the first enemy for 3 s. 30 s cooldown.

race_siren_lure.name: Lure
race_siren_lure.description: Mobs within 10 blocks walk toward you for 3 s, not attacking. 45 s cooldown.

race_siren_lullaby.name: Lullaby
race_siren_lullaby.description: Make yourself and the nearest player able to sleep at any time for 60 s. 20 min cooldown.

race_ogre_heave.name: Heave
race_ogre_heave.description: Pick up and throw the creature in front of you 5 blocks. 20 s cooldown.

race_ogre_big_appetite.name: Big Appetite
race_ogre_big_appetite.description: Eat a full meal at once: fill all hunger and saturation. 5 min cooldown.

race_land_shark_burrow_dive.name: Burrow Dive
race_land_shark_burrow_dive.description: Dive into soft ground and pop up 8 blocks ahead. 20 s cooldown.

race_land_shark_gulp.name: Gulp
race_land_shark_gulp.description: Eat raw fish and meat for double food for 60 s. 3 min cooldown.

race_kirin_purifying_light.name: Purifying Light
race_kirin_purifying_light.description: Clear all harmful effects from you and players within 6 blocks. 2 min cooldown.

race_kirin_blessing.name: Blessing
race_kirin_blessing.description: Luck and Regeneration I for 30 s to you and a nearby player. 3 min cooldown.

race_raptus_talon_dive.name: Talon Dive
race_raptus_talon_dive.description: Dive at the spot you look at; land with a 4-damage hit nearby. 20 s cooldown.

race_raptus_feather_fall.name: Feather Fall
race_raptus_feather_fall.description: Slow Falling for 30 s. 60 s cooldown.

race_rat_swarm_call.name: Swarm Call
race_rat_swarm_call.description: Two rats fight for you for 15 s. 90 s cooldown.

race_rat_hoard.name: Hoard
race_rat_hoard.description: Store 9 items in a hidden pocket you can open anywhere. Always on.

race_shadow_shadow_pocket.name: Shadow Pocket
race_shadow_shadow_pocket.description: Store your held item in the shadows and take it back anywhere. 30 s cooldown.

race_shadow_grasp.name: Grasp
race_shadow_grasp.description: Shadow hands root the enemy you look at for 2 s. 15 s cooldown.

race_sporeling_spore_burst.name: Spore Burst
race_sporeling_spore_burst.description: Spores make enemies within 4 blocks cough (Slowness, Weakness) for 4 s. 30 s cooldown.

race_sporeling_healing_spores.name: Healing Spores
race_sporeling_healing_spores.description: Players within 6 blocks get Regeneration I for 8 s. 90 s cooldown.

race_stoneborn_stone_shape.name: Stone Shape
race_stoneborn_stone_shape.description: Raise a 3-block stone wall in front of you for 30 s. 45 s cooldown.

race_stoneborn_eat_stone.name: Eat Stone
race_stoneborn_eat_stone.description: Eat a cobblestone block for 4 food. 30 s cooldown.

race_infernal_brimstone_meal.name: Brimstone Meal
race_infernal_brimstone_meal.description: Eat charcoal or coal for 3 food. 30 s cooldown.

race_infernal_fire_breath.name: Fire Breath
race_infernal_fire_breath.description: Breathe fire in a short cone for 3 s. 30 s cooldown.

race_dryad_grow_tree.name: Grow Tree
race_dryad_grow_tree.description: Grow a sapling you look at into a tree at once. 2 min cooldown.

race_dryad_entangle.name: Entangle
race_dryad_entangle.description: Roots hold enemies within 4 blocks for 2 s. 30 s cooldown.

race_orc_intimidate.name: Intimidate
race_orc_intimidate.description: Enemies within 8 blocks get Weakness I for 8 s. 60 s cooldown.

race_orc_trophy.name: Trophy
race_orc_trophy.description: Your next kill drops its head or a bone. 3 min cooldown.

race_kobold_skitter.name: Skitter
race_kobold_skitter.description: Speed II and step up full blocks for 8 s. 45 s cooldown.

race_kobold_pack_tactics.name: Pack Tactics
race_kobold_pack_tactics.description: Allies within 8 blocks deal 10% more for 10 s. 90 s cooldown.

race_revenant_raise_servant.name: Raise Servant
race_revenant_raise_servant.description: Raise a skeleton that fights for you for 30 s. 2 min cooldown.

race_revenant_lantern_of_souls.name: Lantern of Souls
race_revenant_lantern_of_souls.description: A soul lantern light that follows you for 2 minutes. 3 min cooldown.

race_wolf_blooded_call_pack.name: Call Pack
race_wolf_blooded_call_pack.description: Two wolves fight for you for 30 s. 3 min cooldown.

race_wolf_blooded_moon_sight.name: Moon Sight
race_wolf_blooded_moon_sight.description: Night Vision for 2 minutes at night. 3 min cooldown.

race_frostborn_whiteout.name: Whiteout
race_frostborn_whiteout.description: A 6-block snowstorm around you for 8 s: enemies inside lose track of you and are slowed. 2 min cooldown.

race_frostborn_frost_walk.name: Frost Walk
race_frostborn_frost_walk.description: For 30 s, water freezes under your feet and you don't sink in powder snow. 90 s cooldown.

race_stormkin_thunderhead.name: Thunderhead
race_stormkin_thunderhead.description: Call a lightning bolt on the spot you look at (24 blocks). 45 s cooldown.

race_stormkin_call_the_rain.name: Call the Rain
race_stormkin_call_the_rain.description: Start rain (or stop it) in your area. 20 min cooldown.

race_dunekin_mirage.name: Mirage
race_dunekin_mirage.description: Leave an illusion of yourself that draws mobs for 6 s while you become invisible for 3 s. 90 s cooldown.

race_dunekin_sandstorm.name: Sandstorm
race_dunekin_sandstorm.description: A 5-block whirl of sand on you for 6 s that blinds and pushes back enemies. 90 s cooldown.

race_sculkborn_sculk_bloom.name: Sculk Bloom
race_sculkborn_sculk_bloom.description: Spread sculk on blocks within 4 blocks, collecting the experience of nearby kills there. 5 min cooldown.

race_sculkborn_echolocation.name: Echolocation
race_sculkborn_echolocation.description: Pulse sound out 24 blocks: every creature and chest glows for you for 8 s. 30 s cooldown.

race_gloomkin_lantern_swarm.name: Lantern Swarm
race_gloomkin_lantern_swarm.description: Summon 6 moths that light your way and follow you for 2 minutes. 5 min cooldown.

race_gloomkin_blinding_dust.name: Blinding Dust
race_gloomkin_blinding_dust.description: Enemies within 4 blocks are blinded for 4 s. 60 s cooldown.

race_faun_herd_speed.name: Herd Speed
race_faun_herd_speed.description: You and allies within 8 get Speed II for 10 s. 2 min cooldown.

race_faun_bound.name: Bound
race_faun_bound.description: Leap 8 blocks forward and up. 20 s cooldown.

race_mimic_chest_form.name: Chest Form
race_mimic_chest_form.description: Turn into a chest until you move; mobs ignore you. 30 s cooldown.

race_mimic_copycat.name: Copycat
race_mimic_copycat.description: Take the shape of the mob you look at for 60 s: its kind ignore you. 5 min cooldown.

race_illagerkin_vex_scout.name: Vex Scout
race_illagerkin_vex_scout.description: Send a vex to scout ahead and show mobs it sees for 20 s. 2 min cooldown.

race_illagerkin_raid_horn.name: Raid Horn
race_illagerkin_raid_horn.description: Call 2 pillager allies for 60 s. 10 min cooldown.

race_piglinborn_hoglin_call.name: Hoglin Call
race_piglinborn_hoglin_call.description: Call a tame hoglin to ride for 5 minutes. 15 min cooldown.

race_piglinborn_barter.name: Barter
race_piglinborn_barter.description: Trade a gold ingot for a piglin barter roll. 30 s cooldown.

race_kitsune_illusion.name: Illusion
race_kitsune_illusion.description: Create 2 copies of yourself that run off for 5 s. 90 s cooldown.

race_kitsune_shapeshift.name: Shapeshift
race_kitsune_shapeshift.description: Turn into a fox for 60 s: small, fast, silent. 3 min cooldown.

race_curse_bonded_spirit_storage.name: Spirit Storage
race_curse_bonded_spirit_storage.description: Store up to 27 items in the spirit. 10 s cooldown.

race_curse_bonded_hold_tight.name: Hold Tight
race_curse_bonded_hold_tight.description: The spirit grabs a falling ally or you, preventing fall damage for 10 s. 60 s cooldown.

race_vessel_shrug_off.name: Shrug Off
race_vessel_shrug_off.description: Remove every harmful effect and heal 4. 2 min cooldown.

race_vessel_superhuman_leap.name: Superhuman Leap
race_vessel_superhuman_leap.description: Jump 6 blocks high with no fall damage. 20 s cooldown.

race_umbral_rabbit_escape.name: Rabbit Escape
race_umbral_rabbit_escape.description: Shadow rabbits hide you: mobs lose your target, invisible 3 s. 90 s cooldown.

race_umbral_divine_dogs.name: Divine Dogs
race_umbral_divine_dogs.description: Two shadow dogs track and fight for you for 60 s. 3 min cooldown.

race_shrinekin_know_your_place.name: Know Your Place
race_shrinekin_know_your_place.description: The mob you look at is forced to kneel: stunned for 2 s (bosses too). Humanoid mobs and players kneel for 10 s. 45 s cooldown.

race_shrinekin_call_uraume.name: Call Uraume
race_shrinekin_call_uraume.description: Uraume, a white snow fox, follows you for 30 s and casts ice spells at your enemies. 5 min cooldown.
